change: Carries the 76d7750 candidate forward with three merged, reviewed changes: the voice DMO fallback hook fix (the game's speech-decoder Init devirtualised to __cxa_pure_virtual, now bound explicitly through the C vtable, with the engine_patch arena_base, capture log_handle/shutdown and loader detach that go with it), the screen-emission bullet bound near-plane clip (project_box cuts the locked-prefix box at clip z = 0, BehindNear reason, capped capture-only packed_sample diagnostic), and the ambient-occlusion step 1b pass, which is detached and unreferenced at runtime. The launcher resolves the linear distance fade route on by default. No new default enables the AO pass and no shipping behavior changes beyond the fade route default and the hook fix.
